caption: Artist Lina Jouni holds a shrapnel mask with painted eyes and glasses over her face.

Düzce, Turkey People sit on a swing at Topuk Plateau, at an altitude of 1,280 metres. In autumn the plateau showcases shades of green, yellow and brown, with dense forests and a lake surrounded by woodlands.
Rio de Janeiro, Brazil Supporters of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva celebrate the election results. Lula won the presidential runoff election against Flávio Bolsonaro.
Lebanon Visual artist Lina Jouni holds an artwork depicting a face wearing glasses, created from Israeli military munitions that she collected.

London, UK The London mayor, Sadiq Khan, looks up at a drone after a photocall in the middle of Oxford Street as the first phase of permanently pedestrianising London’s busy shopping thoroughfare begins.

Banten province, Indonesia Men ride a motorbike past the remnants of a mosque and houses in Somang village that have reemerged after the water levels in the Karian reservoir dropped amid prolonged drought.
Naucalpan, Mexic0 Comando, a chihuahua serving in the National Guard, performs a demonstration at the 1A military camp.
Orléans, France A protester is detained at the launch rally for Marine Le Pen’s presidential campaign.

Caracas, Venezuela María Corina Machado, the Venezuelan opposition leader and Nobel peace prize laureate, greets supporters upon her arrival in Caracas. She returned to her home country after almost a year in exile, greeting ecstatic supporters at a church in the city of Barquisimeto.
Mexico City, Mexico Dance troupes take part in a parade as part of the Paquiliztli fair, a celebration of Indigenous peoples and neighbourhoods, at the Monument to the Revolution.

Anhui province, China Power technicians work at a construction site for the ±800kV ultra-high-voltage, direct-current transmission project along the Yangtze River in Wuhu. It will stretch 2,370km from Gansu province in north-west China to Zhejiang province in the east. Once operational, it will be able to transmit more than 36bn kWh of electricity.
Zurich, Switzerland People walk and cycle past autumnal trees on Sechseläutenplatz.
Gaza City Mourners grieve during the funeral of three Palestinians after they were killed in an Israeli strike on the Islamic University building.
Women dressed as ghosts next to a large skull pose in marigold fields for Day of the Dead.
Eastbourne, UK On a cold yet sunny start to the day in East Sussex the ‘Hunks and Trunks’ cold water sea swimmers take a dip.
Belgrade, Serbia A man, carrying his dog, leaves a polling station after casting his ballot as people queue to vote during the parliamentary elections.
São Paulo, Brazil Luiz Inácio Lula Da Silva, the incumbent president of Brazil, waves a flag in one hand and the constitution in the other during a rally before the presidential runoff.
Frankfurt, Germany A tourist takes photos in Römerberg square after rainfall.
Paris, France French police in riot gear during clashes at a demonstration in the capital.
Perry, Georgia, US An attender holds a novelty dollar bill featuring an image of Donald Trump during a rally.

Šilutė, Lithuania Armed members of the Lithuanian Riflemen’s Union, playing the role of a hostile force, simulate an attack during a Black Hawk 26 exercise. The Riflemen’s Union is a civilian national guard of 20,000 volunteers.
Saint Paul, Minnesota, US The protest group Handmaids of Minnesota host a day of action at the Minnesota state capitol building.
Gaza City, Gaza The circus artist and instructor Ahmed Abu Haloub performs for children inside a building belonging to the Islamic University, which sustained heavy damage during Israeli attacks.
New Brighton, UK Waves crash over the sea wall as Storm Boleo sweeps across parts of the UK.
Lisbon, Portugal A protester wears a model of a house at a demonstration organised by the Acampada de Lisboa in support of the right to housing.
Saint-Denis, France A Steelers fan’s beard is adorned with French related ephemera at an NFL football game between Pittsburgh Steelers and New Orleans Saints.
Savannah, Georgia, US Helen Mirren poses for a portrait at the 29th Scad Savannah film festival where she received the 2026 legend of entertainment award.
Gangqie Township, China Children play with toy cars at a relocation site after a magnitude 7.0 earthquake struck Baqing County, killing 16 people and injuring 76 others.
Masked protesters strike a tourism office with poles amid scattered papers in Lyon.

Kyiv, Ukraine A woman looks at the damage inside her house after a Russian aerial attack in Kyiv. Russia carried out a massive ‘demonstrative’ attack on Ukraine, bombarding Kyiv with ballistic missiles, hours after Vladimir Putin said he had agreed to resume trilateral negotiations after talks with the US envoy Steve Witkoff.

Zaporizhzhia, Ukraine Soldiers who withdrew from a position in Zaporizhzhia they had held for more than 10 months. The Ukrainian president, Volodymyr Zelenskyy, said this week that he was grateful to those among Ukraine’s western partners who saw ‘the situation for what it is’ and ‘acknowledged the reality’ that the Kremlin had little intention of stopping its war. He called for stronger air defences, Patriot interceptors that could bring down enemy missiles, and more sanctions against Moscow.

caption: St Petersburg, Russia People watch a burning oil terminal after an air attack. Russia’s defence ministry said its forces had destroyed 1,015 Ukrainian drones over 15 Russian regions, the annexed Ukrainian peninsula of Crimea and the Black Sea.

Paris, France A protester watches a car burn during a demonstration. Partial curfews were issued for a number of French cities, including parts of Paris, after the government admitted police ‘lost control’ during violent weekend protests around the country.
Gaza City Palestinian women and children watch a strongman championship from among the rubble of destroyed buildings.
Gaza City Palestinian family members look out from their destroyed home after an Israeli airstrike in western Gaza City.

Abu Falah, West Bank Israeli soldiers stand beside a wounded Palestinian man lying on a road after they shot him following a settler attack on Palestinians harvesting olives in the West Bank village of Abu Falah. Israeli settler militants attacked European diplomats, a French mayor and the archbishop of Cambrai in Taybeh, in the occupied West Bank, injuring three people and damaging a car, in the latest violent attempt to prevent Palestinians from harvesting olives on their own land.

Hebron, West Bank One of two armed Palestinian men aims his handgun while exchanging fire with Israeli forces at the northern checkpoint of Hebron. Benjamin Netanyahu ordered the army to prepare for a ‘very extensive’ operation in the occupied West Bank after two Israeli soldiers and two Palestinians were killed.

Taiz, Yemen Saudi-backed Yemeni government fighters fire a truck-mounted recoilless rifle during battles against Iran-allied Houthis at the Jabal Han front, west of the city of Taiz. Houthi forces have largely encircled the city of more than 900,000 people, cutting it off from most supply routes.
Tirana, Albania A hooded protester aims fireworks at police during clashes at an anti-government demonstration.

Tirana, Albania A demonstrator puts her hands on a police officer’s riot shield as students hold an anti-government protest. Lawmakers clashed in Albania’s parliament as opposition MPs attempted to disrupt a session, throwing objects and ripping microphones from the desks of members of the ruling majority. Several opposition MPs held up images of students injured by police during protests in the capital.

Delhi, India Security personnel detain the All India Students’ Association president, Neha Bora, during a protest demanding India’s chief election commissioner Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation over alleged voter roll irregularities. An Indian court ordered the release of two leaders of India’s Cockroach movement who were jailed last week amid a mounting state crackdown on youth-led protests. Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka had spent a week in Delhi’s Tihar jail after being arrested by Delhi police last week.

Palangkaraya, Indonesia A man uses a tree branch to try to extinguish a peatland fire. Students across Kalimantan and Sumatra took to the streets this week to demand government accountability for wildfires and the toxic haze blanketing the region.

San Clemente, California, US A firefighter looks on as smoke billows from the Norte Fire. At least six homes burned , and two firefighters were injured after a fast-moving wildfire blazed through parts of southern California .

Bend, Oregon, US Children place flowers at a makeshift memorial outside Silver Rail Elementary in Bend after a deadly shooting. A teacher wounded in last week’s shooting at the school shared her account of the incident, and how she was shot before she could intervene and ‘[pretended] to be dead’ .

Democratic Republic of Congo Marie Bakikula, a caregiver at a Unicef-supported nursery, poses for a photograph in Mongbwalu. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, several hundred Ebola orphans are being taken in at emergency nurseries set up at the epicentre of the epidemic, which continues to spread nearly six months after its official declaration.

Sao Paulo, Brazil Supporters of Brazil’s right-wing senator and Liberal party presidential candidate Flavio Bolsonaro hold a giant Brazilian flag during a rally on Paulista Avenue in Sao Paulo. Deforestation in the Brazilian Amazon has fallen to its lowest level since records began, new government data shows. But whether this globally important success is maintained or reversed is on a knife edge ahead of a presidential election run-off on 25 October between two candidates with sharply different visions for the future of the rainforest and how that affects relations with the US under Donald Trump.
Foz do Iguacu, Brazil A tourist stands on a walkway overlooking Iguazu Falls in Foz do Iguacu.

St Andrews, Scotland Students from St Andrews University take part in a foam fight, as part of ‘Raisin Monday’ in the Lower College Lawn. During the tradition, older students adopt first year students as ‘children’ and help guide them in a system of mentoring.
